events.title: Storm Grill Demo is out now!
events.summary: Storm Grill Demo is now available on Steam!The wait is over. The demo is finally here and ready for everyone to play. After months of development and feedback from the playtests, the demo is polished and ready for you to experience.The Playtest Is OverThank you to everyone who participated in the playtests. events.title: Quests, Levels, Optimization
events.summary: A new update is now available for Storm Grill Demo Playtest!This update introduces quests, levels, experience, performance improvements, and more as the demo gets closer to its release on Steam.
